segment.source: Wrap a card to emphasize an important workspace summary without changing the card interaction model.
segment.target: 包裹卡片以强调重要的工作台概览，同时不改变卡片自身交互模型。

segment.source: Basic
segment.target: 基础

segment.source: Other
segment.target: 其他

segment.source: Review task status, deployment health, and recent automation activity in one custom container.
segment.target: 在一个自定义容器中查看任务状态、部署健康度和最近的自动化活动。

segment.source: BorderBeam can decorate any Avalonia container. When the content does not implement IBorderBeamAwareControl, set matching BorderThickness and CornerRadius on BorderBeam.
segment.target: BorderBeam 可以装饰任意 Avalonia 容器。当内容未实现 IBorderBeamAwareControl 时，请在 BorderBeam 上设置与容器一致的 BorderThickness 和 CornerRadius。

segment.source: Custom container
segment.target: 自定义容器

segment.source: Stop positions use the public 0-100 input range.
segment.target: 色标位置使用公开的 0–100 输入范围。

segment.source: Display six gradient beam palettes and switch between them.
segment.target: 展示六组渐变流光配色，并在它们之间切换。

segment.source: Customized color
segment.target: 自定义颜色

segment.source: The original pacing for most emphasized containers.
segment.target: 适合大多数强调型容器的默认节奏。

segment.source: Default
segment.target: 默认

segment.source: Use Duration to control how long the beam takes to complete one loop. The default is 6 seconds.
segment.target: 使用 Duration 控制流光完成一圈所需的时间，默认值为 6 秒。

segment.source: A quick loop for temporary highlights and active modules.
segment.target: 快速循环适用于临时强调和活跃模块。

segment.source: Fast
segment.target: 快速

segment.source: A calmer loop for persistent panels and ambient surfaces.
segment.target: 舒缓循环适用于常驻面板和环境式界面。

segment.source: Slow
segment.target: 慢速

segment.source: Duration
segment.target: 动画时长

segment.source: Set BorderThickness to match the border width of this container.
segment.target: 设置 BorderThickness，使流光线宽与此容器的边框宽度一致。

segment.source: Custom line width
segment.target: 自定义线宽

segment.source: Use BorderThickness to adjust the beam width. Its default value follows the shared border thickness token.
segment.target: 使用 BorderThickness 调整流光线宽，其默认值跟随共享边框厚度 Token。

segment.source: Line width
segment.target: 线宽

segment.source: Set Count to distribute multiple beams evenly around the container border.
segment.target: 设置 Count 可沿容器边界均匀分布多个光束。

segment.source: Multiple beams
segment.target: 多光束

segment.source: Use Count to distribute multiple beams evenly along one container boundary.
segment.target: 使用 Count 沿同一容器边界均匀分布多个光束。

segment.source: Multiple beams
segment.target: 多光束

segment.source: The top corners keep a larger radius while the bottom corners remain square.
segment.target: 顶部圆角保持较大半径，底部角保持直角。

segment.source: Set Outset to 0 when the decorated container clips its own corners.
segment.target: 被装饰容器自行裁剪圆角时，可将 Outset 设置为 0。

segment.source: Non-uniform radius
segment.target: 非统一圆角

segment.source: BorderBeam wraps a content control and renders a non-interactive beam on its border. It is decorative, stays active independently of the global motion setting by default, and can use a solid color or gradient stops.
segment.target: BorderBeam 包裹一个内容控件，并在其边界上渲染不参与交互的流光层。它只承担装饰性强调，默认不受全局动效设置影响，并支持单色或渐变停靠点。

segment.source: Draw an animated highlight along a container boundary.
segment.target: 沿容器边界绘制动态高光。

segment.source: Examples
segment.target: 示例

segment.source: The border beam appears when the pointer moves over this card.
segment.target: 当指针移到此卡片上时，边框流光会显示。

segment.source: Hover over the card
segment.target: 将指针移到卡片上

segment.source: Hide the border beam by default, and reveal it when hovering over the container.
segment.target: 默认隐藏流光，当指针悬停在容器上时显示。

segment.source: Show on hover
segment.target: 悬停显示

segment.source: Keeps the highlight shorter for dense card groups.
segment.target: 为密集卡片组使用较短的高光段。

segment.source: Compact
segment.target: 紧凑

segment.source: Uses the default 100px visible beam segment.
segment.target: 使用默认的 100px 可见流光段。

segment.source: Default
segment.target: 默认

segment.source: Use BeamSize to control the size of the visible beam segment. The default is 100 device-independent pixels.
segment.target: 使用 BeamSize 控制可见流光段的尺寸，默认值为 100 个设备无关像素。

segment.source: Creates a longer highlight for wider feature panels.
segment.target: 为较宽的功能面板创建更长的高光段。

segment.source: Extended
segment.target: 扩展

segment.source: Size
segment.target: 尺寸
